body: I step back slowly, my heart racing as I peer out from behind the desk. The light from the fluorescent ceiling flickers ominously. A shadow moves just beyond reach on the wall. Fear tightens in my chest but I force myself forward. I hear footsteps outside, approaching rapidly. My breaths come faster, each one more desperate than the last.
